capability: typed MarketDesk producer authentication health on the incumbent runtime plane
source_of_truth: Git commit plus current release manifest
changes: Preserve the original recovery manifest as immutable provenance.
Persist producer authentication health in the existing MarketDesk SQLite meta table.
Expose AUTHENTICATED, AUTH_REQUIRED, or UNKNOWN through marketdesk status and the existing read-only feed probe.
Make the existing research-feed watcher surface AUTH_REQUIRED without opening a second scheduler, health database, or automatic authentication path.
non_goals: No MarketDesk re-authentication or browser-profile mutation.
No LaunchAgent activation, restart, retirement, or replacement.
No queue, database schema table, bucket, scheduler, workflow, or publication-authority change.
No automatic credential refresh; re-authentication remains an explicit human single-writer operation.
